Abomination Pet Family:
ALL pets receive buffs across the board to their cooldowns and scaling, making them stronger and better to use. Respawning in a battleground now makes you and your pet full HP and mana.
Soul Shards requirements have been removed for every spell and ability in the game. This means you can summon voidwalker without a soul shard generator or create a healthstone.
Norgannon now also increases quest experience in addition to increasing mob kill experience.
Prestige Aura now gives 25% boost to all experience gained. This will help keep the first leveling experience well-paced while letting you zoom in your prestige runs.

Many of Ascension's patches have been split to vastly improve download speeds. This means when we push an update to an achievement or to a creature, the patch is going to be far less large. Frequently updated patches have their own patches containing just those specific files that needed updates. This will reduce the amount you need to download by hundreds of MB at a time.
Cross-Faction Guilds have been enabled. You can now create guilds and have both Horde and Alliance in the same guild.
Overhauled the Trial UI to improve its performance and make it more user-friendly.

Overhauled the Character Advancement to improve its performance, make it more user friendly and overhauls the Hero Architect. This will make using the interfaces much less laggy. This also adds a lot of new functionality for build creation.
